welcome: You stand in the sun-drenched town square of Oaktaven. In the center, a marble fountain splashes where weary warriors wash their blades. Hanging from a large oak tree is the Town Board, cluttered with bloody announcements and warnings. Around the edges of the square, shady figures whisper about the horrors of the Green Dragon.
rumor1: A one-legged veteran spits into the fountain and looks at your gear. 'Listen well, rookie. If you head into the forest with pockets full of gold, you're just bait for thieves and monsters. The dwarves at the bank are grumpy, but at least their vault is safe!'
rumor2: A market woman suddenly grabs your arm. Her eyes are wide with fear. 'Don't go too deep into the forest, young hero! Last night I saw the sky light up green over the mountains. The Dragon hungers for fresh meat... he spares no one!'
rumor3: A figure in a deep hood leans against the tavern wall. 'If your weapon feels blunt, you should offer the Bard a drink,' he whispers. 'His songs can sharpen your blade better than the finest blacksmith in town.'
rumor4: A man with a pan on his head repeatedly runs laps around the fountain and shouts: 'The database is offline! The database is offline! Reindeer steak for everyone!' The townsfolk completely ignore him.
healer_welcome: You push open the creaking wooden door and step into a dim hut filled with bundles of dried flowers, roots, and vials of strange, brightly colored liquids. Behind a table stacked with mortars stands Althea, a friendly old woman with glittering eyes. She takes one look at your wounds and shakes her head. 'Ah, the forest has been rough on you again, eh? Come, sit, my herbs can ease your pain... for a small fee, of course.'
healer_success: Althea applies a cooling, greenish salve to your wounds and hands you a bitter tea. The pain vanishes almost instantly, and you feel your strength rushing back!
healer_healthy: Althea gently pushes you toward the door: 'You have the energy of a young bull, why waste my time? Go back to the square and make room for those who are actually wounded!'
dark_alley_welcome: You slip into a narrow, foul-smelling alley behind the tavern, far away from the shining fountain and the city guard. From the shadows steps a figure with a scar over his eye and a jagged dagger at his belt. He spits on the ground. 'Well look at that, the infamous traveler. The guards on the square want to hang you, but you're safe with me... as long as your gold jingles. Got dirty business to settle?'
dark_alley_success: Sly takes the gems and lets them roll deftly between his knuckles. He winks grimly. 'I'll bribe a few guards and... adjust the official log on the town board. From tomorrow, they'll look at you normally again on the square. But stay out of trouble!'
mightye_welcome: In the middle of the square stands an imposing figure wrapped in a gleaming golden cloak. It is MightyE, the legendary benefactor of the realm! He smiles gently: 'Greetings, adventurer. I am here to bless our loyal supporters. Donate a shiny gem to me, and I shall bestow upon you a unique, cosmetic title that everyone on the square will see!'
mightye_success: MightyE raises his hands. A flash of gold blinds the bystanders! 'Splendid! Your generous gift honors the Gods of the database.'
wedding_welcome: Underneath the great oak tree, the Town Elder stands ready with a parchment scroll. Your love interest stands radiantly by your side, nervously playing with the ring. The elder clears his throat: 'Have you both come here to tie the knot and pledge your loyalty to one another through thick and thin?'
wedding_success: The Town Elder steps forward amidst loud cheering from the gathered crowd! 'By the power of Oaktaven,' the elder speaks, 'I hereby declare you partners.' As flower petals drift through the air, you feel stronger than ever before!
wedding_error_married: The Town Elder shakes his head with a smile: 'You are already married, traveler! Go back to the square and enjoy your love.'
wedding_error_no_gold: The Town Elder furrows his brow: 'A wedding ceremony is not free, child. The musicians and flowers cost gold. Come back when you can spare 500 gold coins!'
